title: UserApprovalRequestPayload
description: Payload for the USER_APPROVAL_REQUEST intent. Routes a decision to a human user when an action exceeds agent authority. The orchestrator parks these for HITL resolution.

context_summary.description: Concise human-readable summary the user reads to decide. Should answer: what is being asked, why it requires user-level approval, what happens on approve vs deny.

options.description: Decision options the user can pick.

expires_at.description: UTC deadline. Past this, the request is auto-denied (when expiry sweep is implemented).

requested_by.description: Agent that escalated to the user. Almost always agent_ceo, but other agents may escalate directly for security-driven actions.

related_request_id.description: Reference to the upstream request (purchase, export, etc.) this approval gates.

linked_security_event_id.description: If approval relates to a security incident, the originating SECURITY_EVENT id.

amount.description: Dollar value, if applicable. Helps the user contextualize spend approvals.

priority.description: Surfaces in the approval list; CRITICAL items should be acted on within hours, not days.

default_on_expiry.description: What the system does if no human response by expires_at. 'deny' is safer; 'approve' should be used only for already-low-risk actions.

examples.context_summary: Procurement requests $6,000 from Acme Tools Inc for office expansion hardware. Exceeds CEO+Finance co-approval threshold of $5,000. Vendor risk-reviewed and approved by agent_security. Funding source: capex_q2 budget bucket.
